invariants.rationale: splitAmount is set to at least effectiveMinAmount, which is never less than minAmount.
splitAmount is set to no more than effectiveMaxAmount, which is never greater than maxAmount.
Since minAmount is likely >= 0 and effective ranges are fractions, splitAmount should not be negative.
Since maxAmount is likely <= 1 and all calculations clamp fractions in [0,1], splitAmount should not exceed 1.
splitAmount is clamped to between effectiveMinAmount and effectiveMaxAmount, regardless of their order.
